name: Cultist of Mars
notes: CR 1/8. Fanatic trait. Cult of Mars. Sessions 1-4.
gm_notes: Sessions 1-4. Dark devotion: advantage on saves vs charm and fright. Appears alongside berserkers and in the vault approach. Corruption evidence: players who examine cultist equipment find Mars sigils with an additional mark -- a brand that is NOT standard legionary iconography.
